cases.name: Authentication loading hides prior list immediately and starts no further request
HTTP failure is error state, distinct from confirmed empty organization
GET-only retry preserves existing form draft
Actor ABA cannot accept initial actor response after returning to same account
Organization switch aborts previous request and ignores its late result
Unmount aborts scope; late response cannot request or update another list
Known rows remain available with error state when refresh fails
Old retry callback cannot trigger read in new actor scope

scope: Actual candidate hook mounted in React StrictMode/JSDOM. Synthetic loader isolates lifecycle, error/empty distinction and retry state. Does not yet wire three full pages or prove native/browser/Next/production behavior.
